d:
The mysterious death of former Bangladesh Air Force Flight Lieutenant Tahsif Souri, who rose to prominence for allegedly recording ousted Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina's departure from Dhaka on August 5, 2024, has taken a dramatic turn following fresh revelations by the Police Bureau of Investigation (PBI). After his body was recovered from the Turag River on October 28, investigations revealed that Tahsif jumped into the water while being chased by uniformed police near Tongi’s Mazar slum late at night, an area known for drug activity, while his friend hid nearby.
Production: Pragati Chaurasia
